about: Known exceptions of tools/sourcecheck.py. Each entry is checked, not skipped: a printed_as cell must sit on the marker it names, and every value of a combined row must be printed somewhere in its source. An entry that no longer applies is reported as stale. Add an entry only for a documented convention, with the reason.

printed_as.reason: Census prints Z for a value that rounds to zero; the unit transcribes it as 0 and says so in its unit_note.

combined_rows.reason: Capstone unit: each state row gathers the candidate columns of the five popular-vote blocks on pages 2 to 6, so no single printed line carries it.
